summary: No blocking findings in the current workspace. The round-3 requirements are implemented and backed by passing automated checks plus targeted source/state verification: 6 compact candidates render, ranking logic preserves the required priority order, the first candidate auto-loads into the editor, two-click swaps update immediately with destination-role tier recalculation, score numbers stay hidden in the main UI, and header/headerless paste parsing both work.
strengths: `npm test` and `npm run build` both passed on the inspected workspace state.

`src/lib/optimizer.js` and an independent sample-fixture check confirm 6 unique candidates, valid `1탱 2딜 2힐` composition per team, no duplicate player assignment within a candidate, and ranking ordered by total score difference, role-score-difference sum, tank difference, then unranked difference.

`src/lib/editor.js`, `src/lib/appFlow.js`, and `src/main.js` now keep the editable model coherent after swaps: the visible slots, assignments, role totals, total scores, and unranked counts are rehydrated from slot state, and candidate re-selection loads a fresh editor copy.

`src/lib/render.js`, `src/config/gameConfig.js`, and `src/styles.css` satisfy the UI-facing requirements I checked directly: Korean product copy, compact preview cards for both teams, the required eight tier color classes, and no visible personal/team score labels in the main result UI.

`README.md` and `FINAL_OUTPUT.md` are aligned with the shipped behavior and accurately disclose that the optional real-browser smoke run was skipped here because no Chromium-family binary is available.
verification_run: `npm run test:browser` (fails in this sandbox because no Chromium-family browser binary is installed; the active spec marks this follow-up as non-blocking)

`node --input-type=module` check against `buildBalanceFromClipboard(...)`, `applySlotSelection(...)`, `selectCandidate(...)`, and `renderResult(...)` to verify headerless parsing, 6 visible candidates, hidden score labels, Korean UI text, swap tier recalculation, and editor reset on candidate switch
`node --input-type=module` check against `enumerateValidAssignments(...)` and `getTopCandidates(...)` to verify candidate count, ordering, and `1/2/2` role shape
`rg -n "Final Edit|compact preview|TANK|DPS|SUP" dist src README.md FINAL_OUTPUT.md`
release_readiness: Release-ready for this iteration. Residual risk remains around optional real-browser smoke execution because Chromium is unavailable in this sandbox, but that gap is explicitly documented and is non-blocking under the current spec.
